finalText:
**Big but shallow.** About 1,291 hits in 94 files, and most are one safe mechanical rename.

| Must not rename | Hits | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `vendor/reporting-sdk/` | 20 | `npm run vendor:refresh` overwrites it |
| `migrations/*.sql` | 61 | Already applied in prod |
| SQL in `services/*/repo/` | 125 lines | Column stays until a rename migration |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | 5 | Public contract |
| `lib/serialize.js` WIRE values | 1 | Frozen wire name |

The rest are JS params and locals. Those rename fine.

Next: sign off on the JS rename only. Keep the wire, DB column, and vendor names as they are.
